description: Domain: config types, merge, env expansion (pure)
details:
Under extensions/mcp/domain/ create small files (<100 lines each), zero I/O and zero SDK/pi imports:
- config-types.ts: RawMcpConfig (mcpServers record), ServerSpec discriminated union {kind: "stdio"|"http"|"sse"} carrying command/args/env/cwd or url/headers, plus shared {name, enabled, lazy, includeTools?, excludeTools?}.
- config-parse.ts: parse one raw entry → ServerSpec | {error} (infer kind: `command` present → stdio; `url` present → type ?? "http"). Unknown keys preserved-but-ignored.
- config-merge.ts: mergeCatalogs(sources: RawMcpConfig[] in precedence order) → Catalog (Map<name, ServerSpec>); later source wins whole-entry per name.
- env-expand.ts: expand `${VAR}` in strings/arrays/records given an env record; missing var → keep literal and collect a warning.

Tests in extensions/mcp/__tests__/ (one file per module, each <100 lines): precedence override, disabled entry, stdio vs http inference, env expansion incl. missing var.

Verify: `bun test extensions/mcp/__tests__` green; `grep -rn "@modelcontextprotocol\|node:fs\|earendil" extensions/mcp/domain/` returns nothing.
notes: Implemented pure config types, parsing, precedence merge, and environment expansion with unit tests; verification passed in commit 00324db.

description: Domain: tool bridging — names, schema sanitizer, result mapp
details:
Under extensions/mcp/domain/ add:
- tool-name.ts: bridgeToolName(server, tool) → sanitized `<server>_<tool>` in [a-zA-Z0-9_-], plus deterministic collision resolution over a set of taken names (_2, _3).
- schema-sanitize.ts (+ schema-sanitize-rules.ts if needed for the 100-line cap): sanitizeInputSchema(jsonSchema) → {schema} | {skip: reason}. Rules: default type object; strip $schema; additionalProperties passthrough; inline or reject $ref; string enum → {type:"string", enum:[...]} (StringEnum shape); drop unsupported keywords (patternProperties, allOf, if/then). Never throw.
- result-map.ts: mapContent(mcpContentBlocks) → pi content blocks (text passthrough, image → pi image, unknown → JSON text) — pure; truncation applied by the adapter (truncateHead lives in the pi package, not importable here).
- tool-filter.ts: applyFilters(tools, includeTools?, excludeTools?) with exact-name matching.

Tests: one file per module covering name sanitization+collision, enum conversion, $ref rejection, image mapping, include/exclude.

Verify: bun tests green; domain purity grep from t-004 still clean; all files <100 lines.
notes: Added tool naming, schema sanitization, result mapping, filtering, and unit coverage; purity and file-length verification passed in commit 5758036.

description: Application: ports + use cases (connect, sync tools, call to
details:
Under extensions/mcp/application/ define ports and use cases (<100 lines/file):
- ports.ts: interface McpConnectionPort {connect(spec): Promise<void>; listTools(): Promise<RemoteTool[]>; callTool(name, args, signal?): Promise<McpToolResult>; close(): Promise<void>; state: ConnectionState}; interface ToolRegistryPort {register(bridged: BridgedTool, handler): void}; interface ConfigSourcePort {loadSources(cwd, projectTrusted): RawMcpConfig[]}.
- connect-server.ts: use case — given ServerSpec + connection factory, drive idle→connecting→ready/failed, collect failure reason (never throw to caller).
- sync-tools.ts: use case — for a ready connection: listTools → applyFilters → sanitize+bridge each → register via ToolRegistryPort; return {registered: string[], skipped: {tool, reason}[]}.
- call-tool.ts: use case — resolve bridged name → connection, invoke callTool with signal, map result via domain result-map, convert isError:true into a thrown Error carrying the mapped text.
- manager.ts: ConnectionManager holding Map<name, Connection wrapper>, startAll(catalog) (direct+stdio only in this plan; skip lazy/remote with recorded notices), stopAll() idempotent.

Tests with in-memory fake ports (no SDK): state transitions, filter+skip accounting, isError→throw, stopAll idempotency.

Verify: bun tests green; application/ imports domain only (grep for "infrastructure/" and "@modelcontextprotocol" under application/ → nothing).
notes: Added application ports, connection manager, connect/sync/call use cases, and fake-port tests; import-purity and test gate passed in commit 634d5f1.

description: Infrastructure: SDK stdio client adapter + config file loade
details:
Under extensions/mcp/infrastructure/:
- sdk-connection.ts: implements McpConnectionPort using Client from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js + StdioClientTransport from .../client/stdio.js (command/args/env/cwd from ServerSpec; child env = minimal inherit of PATH/HOME merged with spec env). Rely on caller AbortSignal + SDK defaults for timeouts. close() awaits transport close.
- config-loader.ts: implements ConfigSourcePort — read the 4 config paths (paths built in a separate paths.ts: honor $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR for the pi agent dir else ~/.pi/agent; ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json; cwd files), tolerate missing files, JSON.parse errors → collected warning + skip source, run domain env-expand at load time. Project sources only when projectTrusted.

Tests: config-loader against a temp-dir fixture with injected paths (make paths injectable — do not monkeypatch os); sdk-connection gets covered by t-008 integration.

Verify: bun tests green; only infrastructure/ and __tests__ import @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (`grep -rln "@modelcontextprotocol" extensions/mcp | grep -v infrastructure | grep -v __tests__` → empty).
notes: Implemented SDK stdio adapter and trusted config loader/path discovery in commit b030c4c; SDK import-boundary check and typecheck passed before t-009.

description: Composition root: index.ts wiring + pi tool registry adapter
details:
Precondition: none — this task only adds files and registers tools; nothing existing is removed. (Pi offers no tool-unregistration API; when a server withdraws a tool mid-session we keep the pi registration and make its execute throw a clear "tool withdrawn by server" error — document this limitation in README.)

- infrastructure/pi-registry.ts: implements ToolRegistryPort over pi.registerTool: for each BridgedTool register {name, label, description prefixed `[MCP:<server>] `, parameters: sanitized schema cast to TypeBox TSchema, execute: delegates to call-tool use case with signal; applies truncateHead(DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES/DEFAULT_MAX_LINES) to text output}.
- extensions/mcp/index.ts (composition root, <100 lines): factory does wiring only; on session_start → loadSources(ctx.cwd, ctx.isProjectTrusted()) → mergeCatalogs → manager.startAll → sync-tools per ready connection → ctx.ui.notify summary (`MCP: N servers, M tools` + failures); on session_shutdown → manager.stopAll(). Subscribe to tools/list_changed notification → re-run sync-tools for that server (additions registered; withdrawals handled per precondition note).
- Skipped remote/lazy servers appear in the notify summary as "deferred (remote/lazy support pending)".

Verify: `npm test` green. Manual gate: in a temp dir write .mcp.json {"mcpServers": {"everything": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything"]}}}; run `pi -e /Users/jalbarran/fun/drekki/pi-mcp/extensions/mcp -p "call the everything server echo tool with message hi"` and confirm the tool executes. STOP if pi cannot load the extension.
notes: Bumped pi dev dependencies to 0.80.7, wired session lifecycle and MCP tool-list notifications, and added pi registry details. npm test and the approved print-mode server-everything smoke test passed.
